answer: Admit newcomers only through a garden of scarce seasonal slots: each epoch auctions a few bonded admission slots, and the winner pays a stake and receives a hollow credential that gains standing only as verified jobs fill it. A gale of random spot-checks then re-tests holders on fresh tasks; failing one empties the credential and burns the stake. A Sybil farm must outbid honest agents for every slot and fund a separate stake per fake, while spot-checks make idle shells worthless.
